notes.title: "Alice's World" Steam Page released, the girl hears "your" voice from in front of the screen
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/bcb8ac1e2aa0c4c98220fb152a0303ecce06e954.png[/img]
Alice's World is a story-driven 2D adventure puzzle game.
The girl opens her eyes in a desolate world, and hears "your" voice from in front of the screen.
You can direct her actions, help her solve mysteries, evade dangers, and find a way to leave this place. Of course, you could also choose not to do so, or even worse, deliberately guide her to death... Just kidding, you surely wouldn't do that, right?
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2439560/Alices_World/
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/b49d52caa40ed999c4231937661499124b6de4ac.jpg[/img]
[h2]【Game Features】[/h2]
[list][*]There is no role-playing! You are yourself, sitting in front of the screen, guiding the in-game character.
[*]Explore the stories hidden behind the desolate world, unravel the truth layer by layer.
[*]Exquisite Japanese-style art and full voice acting bring an immersive experience.[/list]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/9e79f45938240209d61449759220516509a38062.jpg[/img][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/4d1759dee13a21b06e099af803e9f7edc449b451.gif[/img][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/ecf8e07845fac84ee2d416a0815515e55ad313e2.jpg[/img]
[h1]【Story Rich】[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/986280/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/766280/

notes.title: "Beyond the Curtains" - Cozy Game Condensing the Stories of Townsfolk
notes.content:
[h2]A Serene Story through the Window[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/04c81e510aae8a0e3cdf77dfaa950ffdbe94c1b9.gif[/img]
Forget the hustle and bustle of everyday life and immerse yourself in a tranquil story unfolding beyond the window. Leisurely observe the landscapes and passing people through the window, capturing moments of soothing tranquility.


[h2]Poetry of Objects[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/20d0e62fce455718faeab30038d7f09cfa8d3d77.gif[/img]
Feeling the owner's profound emotions story through the evolving objects in the room.


[h2]Enjoy at Your Own Pace[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/09dcd9d86538d019a27d52b415639ff54a10e4d2.gif[/img]
Liberate yourself from stress and pressure, taking control of the game's progression at your own pace. With no fear of missing anything, you can savor a delightful healing time.

[h2]Add to Wishlist[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2648940

notes.title: The game soundtrack format has been updated from DLC to Music!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33994611/5a72f87673b5197c43e730d7df396fbf5e8bd82e.jpg[/img]

Hello, players.
STEAM offers developers a new DLC type called "Music" exclusive to the game's soundtrack. You can buy Music-type DLC directly even if you haven't bought the game yet. You can also enjoy the cover of the game's soundtrack simultaneously through STEAM playback.

We've now converted the OSTs for both "Koi musubi" and "LINGUA FLEUR: LILY" to that genre!

We've been working with great composers and that makes us very proud!
In the future, we'll make better music together.

notes.title: Update Schedule
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27595344/70c6846e14ffa5832695713962df42b2d913d2e9.jpg[/img]
（有中文頁面，請切換語言）

Hello players,
For a long time now, Narrator has been working on something new: a music animation!
It is expected that in the future, we will produce hand-painted animations to enrich our game content.
In addition to this, we also anticipate the use of new technologies in our new works.

And we have some more good news to tell you.
We are currently planning a small content expansion and we hope to release two or three easy (but shiny) daily stories.
They will be released in the form of short stories.

The production of these stories will be completed after we finish our current project, but they will hopefully be released by the end of this year.
At present, we are putting all of our efforts into the production of the hand-painted music animation "Koi Bana Seris".

The links to our promotional [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ta8ELxx3bL4]videos[/url]

Check it out!

The full version of the animation is being crowd-funded on Webackers which supports VISA, MasterCard, China UnionPay, and other credit cards.
Physical rewards are only able to be shipped to Taiwan, mainland China, Hong Kong, and Macao.

Since the platform can only be set to "Taiwan & Islands" or "Global", the "Taiwan & Islands" selection also includes Hong Kong and Macao.

If you are interested in this animated work, take a look at what we have created so far!

[url=https://www.webackers.com/Proposal/Display/1065] LINK[/url]

notes.title: The English demo has been launched!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27595344/4f5691d9a1eca072d02c377c62343bd00fe45302.jpg[/img]
Hello players:

We have launched a demo version of Koi Musubi in [b]English[/b], Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese!
The demo version is the first chapter of the game and is about 10,000 words.

We are interested in the feedback from English players of our game, please tell us what you think of it!
Based on the feedback, we will decide whether we will continue to develop a full English version.

If you are a translator and would like to help us, please contact us by e-mail. Thank you!
Special thanks to Jian Jia translation group "風騷的哈里斯基" and "一只小雨", as well as our Canadian editor.

You can download the demo from our store page [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/543930/Koi_Musubi/]Here[/url]

notes.title: English Demo Version Now in Development
notes.content:
Greetings fellow players,

Thank you for your support for Koi Musubi.
The sales are far beyond our expectation,  and we've received many positive feedbacks.

Many of these feedbacks (especially those from the players in English speaking regions) have been asking for an English version of Koi Musubi.

Thus, we've decided to start working on an English Demo, which will include the prologue with more than 10,000 words context.

We'll check on the feedbacks about this demo version,and seek the assistance of localization professionals to see if a complete English version is a viable option.

We are looking forward to deliver this demo to you as soon as possible.

- "7 Days with Death" Now in Greenlight

One of Narrator's previous works: 
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=878835989]7 Days with Death[/url] is now in Steam Greenlight.
It would be greatly helpful for us to bring mores games to Steam if you would vote for "7 Days with Death" to pass the Greenlight.

notes.title: Problem Reporting and Scheduled Fixes
notes.content:

We are currently receiving the following questions
1.Tab + Shift probability will crash
2. Open the game after the white screen

Narrator is an amateur club,

notes.title: Update plan
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27595344/eb297bf737c4e80f7e90efc9ecb186be234e798b.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27595344/42d05d689e976bc0235758e45d2f4a8390427db3.jpg[/img][/url]

After the work we received a lot of recommendations,
This game also needs to be amended.
But because we received a return, found that the current update will result in the player's savedata disappear.
Before the first few push DATA, we use the test account and can not detect this problem.
So the next will slow down the update speed, find the least impact of the treatment.
And made three days after the announcement, update, allowing the player to choose whether to cancel the automatic update.

This is our first time on Steam, but this is not all wrong excuses.
Thank you for the encouragement and tolerance, and introduced the SteamCN forum to us.

This is the first time to see their work with so many players and feedback.
We'll read each comment, whether it's encouraging or modifying the suggestion
On our future development has a great help.

We will strive to produce more and better works.
